lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and holders of 5% or more of its shares agreed not to sell shares for 180 days after the date of the prospectus, with some exceptions.

what: It runs a ticketing and event technology platform for concerts, sports and other live events across Latin America.
proceeds: The company expects about $13.1 million after costs. It plans to use the money to develop its platform, expand abroad, make acquisitions, fund sales and marketing, and for general business needs.
risks: Ticket sales depend on how many live events are held and whether people choose to attend them.
Events like disease outbreaks, attacks, unrest or severe weather could stop events and force the company to refund tickets.
The ticketing industry is very competitive, which could push the company to cut fees, spend more or lose sales.
The company needs to keep attracting and keeping ticket buyers, sellers and event partners, and losing them would hurt its business.
If the company fails to keep improving its platform and launching useful new features, its business will suffer.
